en-US.title: Confirm this operation
en-US.description: Only the requester can confirm this exact operation. Silence does not approve it.
en-US.approved: Confirmation received. The operation will recheck your permissions before continuing.
en-US.denied: Cancelled. The operation was not approved.
en-US.expired: This confirmation has expired or was already used. Request a new preview.
en-US.mismatch: This confirmation belongs to a different requester or conversation.

zh-CN.title: 确认本次操作
zh-CN.description: 只有发起人可以确认这一项操作。不回复不会批准操作。
zh-CN.commands:
确认请发送 {approve}
取消请发送 {deny}
zh-CN.approved: 已收到确认。系统将在继续操作前重新检查你的权限。
zh-CN.expired: 这次确认已过期或已使用，请重新生成预览。
zh-CN.mismatch: 这次确认属于其他发起人或会话。
zh-CN.expires: 本次确认最多保留 {seconds} 秒。
